name: Stealth Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: This advanced optics system can distort light, allowing ST fitted with this backpack model to become somewhat invisible. It can also inflict a DMG Taken UP effect on the enemy.

61228.name: Stealth Device I - DMG UP
61228.SpecificEffects:
At the end of the action, if there are no enemies within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, gain <buf ID=3004502>[Stealth I]</buf> with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.
In combat, the enemy's DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
